messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem for last week's GPU surge. i want to lock owners and a short timeline so we can close the loop. please claim items you own.

maya: ACTIONS: 
1) project quota buffer -> set global default buffer to 10% and expose per-project override (owner: devin) — purpose: avoid sudden quota exhaustion during noisy bursts.
2) scheduler policy -> enable adaptive-packing experiment (start at 0.66, dynamic lower bound) + cap to limit cost drift (owner: sam).
3) headroom & chaos sim -> 72h soak with injected burst patterns and eviction bursts (owner: tana).
4) quota enforcement middleware -> add preflight check that rejects requests when projected_headroom < 5% (owner: devin + infra-ci).
5) canary plan -> progressive ramp across three canaries: 30m smoke, 2h soak, 8h full canary with automatic rollback hook (owner: ops-bot + maya).
6) runbook and alerts -> add a short "surge aftercare" page, include new alert on cost_delta > 8% post-deploy (owner: maya).

maya: timeline: PRs by Thu EOD, sim start Fri, canary next Mon. final rollout contingent on canary + 5 business days of observation.

devin: ill take quota buffer + middleware. will open PR and add unit + integration tests.

sam: adaptive-packing makes sense. i'll run a cost/latency sweep; if cost delta >7% at baseline load we fallback to hybrid packing. i'll post a matrix.

tana: i can run the 72h sim but need traces. maya, drop the S3 path and ill spin up the containerized harness.

maya: s3://redwood-ops/surge-traces/2026-03-peak-mix-v2.tar.lz4 — anonymized. tana ping when you start and i'll tail logs.

ops-bot: ci: created quota-guard PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4325 (created by devin)

infra-ci: smoke tests for quota-guard: passed — unit+mock infra.

devin: PR opened ^. middleware will enforce projected_headroom_pct >= 0.05 at request time. adding feature flag for gradual rollout.

sam: scheduler perf issue created: https://go.redwood/scheduler-adaptive-881 
params being tested: start_pack=0.66, min_pack=0.58, cost_guard_pct=[4,6,8], preempt_backoff_ms=[300,800]

tana: started sim on dev-grid. uploading logs to /sim-results/3290012345.tar.gz. first 12h quick insight: headroom buffer prevented several eviction waves; p99 latency bumped ~3% on the heaviest tails.

maya: thanks. proposed canary abort conditions: eviction_events > 1/min OR p99 uplift > 12% OR cost_delta > 10% for the canary cluster.

devin: noted. enabling feature-flag default=false, will flip in canary only.

ops-bot: canary-runner: initiated canary on prod-canary-7 (id: cr-3290012345). stages: smoke->soak->full.

ops-bot: canary: smoke stage complete (30m) — no evictions, p99 +0.8%. proceeding to soak.

tana: soak 3h in: eviction_count=0, p99 +1.4%, throughput stable. uploading interim grafana snapshot: https://dash.redwood/c/32876/canary-3290012345

sam: standing by for cost impact. if cost_delta trends above 6% after soak we should re-evaluate packing thresholds.

ops-bot: canary: full stage started (8h)

ops-bot: canary: full stage complete (8h) — result=PASS. metrics: eviction_rate=0, p99 +2.1%, cost_delta=+4.5%. auto-promote disabled (manual decision).

maya: excellent. next: devin merge PR after 2 approvals, sam finalize scheduler recommendation (adaptive packing with cost_guard=6%), tana upload final sim report and artifacts, and i will update runbook + create closure ticket.

devin: merging now, will request reviewers.

sam: i'll post final perf matrix and recommended knob values into the issue by EOD.

tana: final report: https://drive.redwood/sim-reports/3290012345-final.pdf — summary: 10% buffer reduces eviction tail ~70%, adaptive-packing at 0.66 keeps p99 within 3% while cost delta ~4-6% depending on min_pack.

maya: thanks team. scheduling a 15-min pulse every Mon for 3 weeks to watch for regression: week1 devin, week2 sam, week3 tana. i'll create calendar invites. once the 3-week window is clean i'll mark the postmortem actions closed in the main doc. :white_check_mark:
